results.name: AdditiveNoise
results.description: Add independent noise to each voxel. Supports uniform, Gaussian, Laplace and centered beta distributions; this example uses Laplace noise.

results.name: Affine
results.description: Rotate, translate and scale the volume, applying the same geometry to images and labels.

results.name: BiasField
results.description: Multiply intensities by a smooth 3D gain field generated from a coarse Gaussian random lattice.

results.name: BlankRectangle
results.description: Fill randomly placed cuboids with a chosen value, simulating missing regions.

results.name: BrightnessAdd
results.description: Add a constant offset to every voxel in the selected image channels.

results.name: BrightnessGradient
results.description: Add a localized Gaussian brightness field. This example fixes its center at the middle of the volume; `loc=(0, 1)` samples a random position. The field is mean-centered by default.

results.name: BrightnessMultiply
results.description: Multiply every voxel in the selected image channels by a brightness factor.

results.name: ChannelMisalignment
results.note: Two input channels (second is a copy of the CT); only channel 1 moves. Both channels are included in timing.
results.description: Independently shift, rotate and scale selected image channels to simulate registration errors. This example moves the second of two identical CT channels.

results.name: CLAHE
results.description: Equalize local histograms in 3D tiles, limit their contrast, and interpolate between neighboring tiles to avoid seams.

results.name: ClipOutliers
results.description: Clip intensities at selected percentiles. This example then restores the original standard deviation.

results.name: Contrast
results.description: Scale intensity differences from the channel mean. The default range-preservation option clips results to the original range.

results.name: CropPad

preview_selection.selection: most affected slices · coordinates mapped by relative grid position

results.description: Crop or pad all aligned targets to a requested ZYX shape. This example takes a centered 112³ crop from the 128³ input.

results.name: Defocus
results.description: Average intensities within a spherical 3D neighborhood to simulate out-of-focus acquisition.

results.name: Elastic
results.note: Strong cubic B-spline example: 64-voxel knot spacing, requested RMS displacement 8 voxels, with border clamping.

preview_selection.selection: most affected interior slices (boundary padding excluded from selection)

animation.caption: Strong cubic B-spline deformation: original → deformed → original. Fixed Z/Y/X slices, seed 125, achieved RMS 5.36 voxels.

results.description: Warp the volume with a smooth random 3D B-spline displacement field, keeping images and labels aligned. The previews use interior slices so boundary padding does not dominate the view.

results.name: Equalize
results.description: Equalize the histogram across the entire volume while retaining the channel intensity range.

results.name: FDA
results.description: Blend low-frequency amplitudes from a reference volume into the 3D Fourier spectrum while preserving the source phase.

results.name: Flip
results.description: Mirror the volume along selected axes. This example always flips X.

results.name: ForegroundCrop

preview_selection.selection: most affected slices · coordinates mapped by relative grid position

results.description: Choose a random crop containing a sampled foreground voxel. All aligned targets follow the crop; empty masks fall back to random cropping.

results.name: ForegroundDropout
results.description: Place cuboids around sampled foreground voxels and erase only foreground inside those cuboids.

results.name: Gamma
results.description: Apply a power-law intensity curve over the channel range, changing the relative brightness of dark and light structures.

results.name: GaussianBlur
results.description: Smooth the volume with a separable 3D Gaussian filter.

results.name: GaussianNoise
results.description: Add independent zero-mean Gaussian noise with the specified standard deviation.

results.name: GibbsRinging
results.description: Truncate high frequencies in the 3D Fourier spectrum, creating ringing around sharp boundaries.

results.name: GridDropout
results.description: Erase a periodic grid of cuboid holes with a randomly sampled offset.

results.name: HistogramMatching
results.description: Match the volume intensity histogram to a reference volume, with optional blending.

results.name: Illumination
results.description: Apply a smooth multiplicative illumination field. Supports directional ramps, corner falloff and Gaussian illumination; this example uses a diagonal ramp.

results.name: Invert
results.description: Reflect intensities around the channel mean, reversing bright and dark structures.

results.name: LocalContrast
results.description: Change contrast around a Gaussian-weighted local mean inside a smooth region.

results.name: LocalGamma
results.description: Blend a gamma-adjusted image into a localized Gaussian region.

results.name: LocalSmoothing
results.description: Blend Gaussian smoothing into a localized region, leaving distant voxels largely unchanged.

results.name: LowResolution
results.description: Downsample and upsample the image to simulate reduced spatial resolution.

results.name: MedianFilter
results.description: Replace each voxel with the median of its 3D neighborhood, suppressing isolated noise while retaining edges.

results.name: Morphology
results.description: Apply a morphological operation to labels. This example closes small gaps using dilation followed by erosion.

results.name: MotionBlur
results.description: Average samples along a 3D line to simulate motion during acquisition.

results.name: MultiplicativeNoise
results.description: Multiply each voxel by an independently sampled uniform random gain.

results.name: Normalize
results.description: Normalize intensities per channel. This example uses z-score normalization of nonzero voxels, keeping zeros unchanged; its display window includes negative values.

results.name: ObjectDropout
results.description: Randomly remove whole connected foreground objects, clearing their image voxels and labels by default.

results.name: OrientedBlur
results.description: Smooth along a specified 3D direction and two perpendicular directions with separate blur widths. This example is aligned with Z.

results.name: PixelDistributionAdaptation
results.description: Transfer reference intensity statistics. The standard mode shown here blends the reference mean and standard deviation; minmax mode transfers the range.

results.name: PlasmaBrightnessContrast
results.description: Use a smooth multiscale 3D random field to vary brightness and contrast throughout the volume.

results.name: PlasmaShadow
results.description: Darken the volume with a smooth multiscale 3D random shadow field.

results.name: RandomBinaryOperator
results.description: Apply a selected binary morphological operation to image channels. This example dilates a thresholded foreground volume.

results.name: RandomToneCurve
results.description: Apply a random monotone nonlinear intensity curve while preserving the channel range endpoints.

results.name: RemoveComponents
results.description: Randomly remove connected foreground components below a size threshold. This example modifies the label mask.

results.name: RicianNoise
results.description: Combine the image with two independent Gaussian noise fields to simulate magnitude-image Rician noise.

results.name: RingingOvershoot
results.description: Apply a separable windowed-sinc filter in 3D, retaining edge overshoot and ringing.

results.name: Rotate90
results.description: Rotate aligned targets by multiples of 90 degrees. This example rotates the YX plane by one quarter turn.

results.name: SaltAndPepper
results.description: Replace selected voxels with the channel minimum or maximum, producing dark and bright impulse noise.

results.name: Sharpen
results.description: Enhance local edges with a discrete Laplacian sharpening filter. This example keeps overshoots instead of clipping them.

results.name: SheetCompression
results.description: Use the CT intensity profile to compress sheet-like structures along a selected axis while transforming aligned targets together.

results.name: ShotNoise
results.description: Sample Poisson photon counts from nonnegative intensities and rescale them, producing signal-dependent shot noise.

results.name: SliceIllumination
results.description: Reduce brightness across selected slices and wider bands to simulate slice-dependent acquisition defects.

results.name: Smear
results.description: Blend shifted copies of preceding slices into each slice to simulate directional smearing.

results.name: StripeMasking
results.description: Erase periodic slabs along selected axes with random offsets; overlapping slabs form a stripe pattern through the volume.

results.name: StripGeometry
results.note: 2D-only companion: central Z slice, not a cubic-volume timing.
results.description: Warp a 2D strip with rotation and a smooth lateral offset. This companion example uses the central Z slice of the CT crop.

results.name: SurfacePerturb
results.note: 2D-only companion: synthetic coordinate surface with CT-derived height. Preview is displacement magnitude, not an anatomical surface.
results.description: Add localized smooth displacements to a 2D coordinate surface. This companion uses a synthetic surface with CT-derived height; the last panel shows displacement magnitude.

results.name: ThickSlice
results.description: Downsample and upsample along selected axes to simulate thicker acquisition slices. Labels follow the same slice mapping.

results.name: Transpose
results.description: Permute spatial axes for all aligned targets. This example exchanges Y and X.

results.name: UnsharpMask
results.description: Add a scaled difference between the image and a Gaussian-smoothed copy to enhance fine structure.

results.name: Vignetting
results.description: Attenuate intensities with a radial falloff in all three dimensions, darkening voxels farther from the center.

results.name: ZoomBlur
results.description: Average multiple 3D zoom states around a center point to create radial blur.
